{{Quote|Take a Cosmic Chance on a rich, flavorful slider inspired by the one and only Gambler's World. Our regular patty is topped with sautéed Vorzydiak mushrooms and three kibi strips. If you're craving something exciting, this is a safe bet.|The description of the slider on the menu|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Vorzydiak mushrooms''' were a type of [[Diet/Legends|edible]] [[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> that shared its name with the [[Vorzydiak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] which were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Vorzyd system/Legends|Vorzyd system]].<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The mushrooms were an ingredient in the [[Vorzyd slider/Legends|Vorzyd slider]] sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[slider]] created by the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]], [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who was inspired<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> by the planet [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]] in the Vorzyd system.<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vorzydiak mushrooms were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
